mapper.select:
select co.*, nvl(apfi.fee_amount_sum,0) fee_amount_sum from ct_abs_product_organization co left join ( select fee.organization_id, sum(fee.fee_amount) fee_amount_sum from ct_abs_pro_fee_info fee group by fee.organization_id ) apfi on apfi.organization_id=co.organization_id 1=1
and co.product_id = #{productId}
and co.bank_account_name like concat('%',concat(#{bankAccountName},'%'))
and co.bank_branch_name like concat('%',concat(#{bankBranchName},'%'))
and co.organization_name like concat('%',concat(#{organizationName},'%'))
